audit_scope: AMP H5 frozen train/dev component grouping and deterministic integer feasibility only

freeze_chain.fact: Freeze binds split protocol, release train/val byte hashes, partition audit, and exact split_v2 candidate copy hashes. Observed release train/val hashes match.
Release audit records independently verified qualification/partition status and binds author split audit. This audit did not repeat that prior full review.
Observed author audit hash matches release reference and binds component-file, split-protocol, split-implementation, and NW reference hashes. Component-file contents were not opened.
Build metadata binds descriptor script, freeze, train/val source hashes, model CSV hashes, and TRAIN_VAL_BINDING hash; all inspected binding hashes match.

component_construction.semantics: Protocol-defined sequence-similarity connected component; not a verified biological family or independent biological unit.
component_construction.vertices: Eligible unique AA sequences plus 31 historical exclusion-marker sequences and 164 old public split-marker sequences, as specified by the frozen protocol; underlying full graph was not reopened.
component_construction.pairwise_rule: Global Needleman-Wunsch, match +2, mismatch -1, linear gap -2 including terminal gaps; maximize tuple (alignment_score, exact_matches, -aligned_columns); edge iff 10*matches >= 7*all_alignment_columns.
component_construction.group_rule: Full transitive connected components; all terminal states of an identical AA sequence share a graph vertex/component.
component_construction.identifier_rule: SHA256 of sorted unique member AA sequences joined by newline without a final newline. Code uses ASCII, which coincides with UTF-8 on these AA strings.
component_construction.assignment_rule: Hash bucket from seed + colon + component_id, modulo 10000; prior-exposure rules override otherwise 80/10/10 train/val/test component assignment. No new assignment performed here.
important_boundaries: Transitive closure does not imply every pair in a component has identity >= 0.70.
Original component hashes may include marker members absent from released train/val; do not reconstruct IDs from only the released subset.
Do not substitute row indices, sequence hashes, source IDs, or terminal labels for component_id.
No pairwise alignment, homology recomputation, full component-file read, or biological-family validation was performed in this audit.

row_binding_verification.method: Read only designated train/val CSV metadata fields, compare frozen binder in original row order; count existing component IDs without sequence comparison.
row_binding_verification.mapping: Use role plus frozen binding.model_row_id (model CSV idx), or unique molecule_sha256, to join to component_id; validate artifact row semantics first. Binding train IDs are 0..278, val IDs are 279..319.
row_binding_verification.local_row_caution: H5 reconstruction_export uses split-local row_id=i+j (vae_pipeline_formal_v2.py:601), so val reconstruction row_id 0..40 needs its val-role offset/binding; it is not a component ID.

integer_feasibility_method.target: Remove whole existing train components while reaching 16 FREE and 16 AMD rows simultaneously.
integer_feasibility_method.algorithm: Deterministic 0/1 integer subset-sum count. Each existing component contributes its (FREE_count, AMD_count). Start count[(0,0)]=1; for each component add an include-copy of prior states with both coordinates <=16. No subset identities selected or emitted. Per-terminal counts analogously use only components with a positive count of that terminal.
integer_feasibility_method.count_semantics: Number of distinct subsets of labeled existing component IDs, not biological samples or independent experimental replicates. Large counts are decimal strings to preserve exact integers.
integer_feasibility_method.denominator_boundary: Independent per-terminal exact16 feasibility does not justify independent draws and a union of their components: the 7 mixed-terminal components can remove extra rows of the other terminal. If a single jointly constrained whole-component subset is later selected with exactly (16,16), the remaining train counts would be FREE110 and AMD137. Those denominators are only conditional arithmetic, not a selected split or completed experiment.

execution_boundaries.manifest_heldout_references_seen: Only paths/counts/hashes already present in allowed split manifests; no referenced heldout data file opened.
